text: China's consumer price index increased 1.0% year over year in June, below May's 1.2%, while the producer price index increased 4.1% year over year, its strongest growth since July 2022. Consumer and producer inflation measures remained separated, with food prices declining and monthly producer prices decreasing 0.3%.

meta.note: Year-over-year and month-over-month producer price measures move in different directions within the same release.
